footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss: includes a $126M income tax benefit.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 17.2% to $147M in 2025. The operating loss narrowed to $562M from $2.2B.
The net loss narrowed to $408M, or −$11.11 per share, from $2.0B. Operating cash flow was −$299M and free cash flow −$300M, versus −$582M.
sources: GRAIL, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

risks: We have incurred significant net losses in each period since our inception and anticipate…
Our NHS-Galleri Trial did not meet its stated primary endpoint, which may adversely affect our business, stock price…
Our products or future products may not perform as expected, and the results of our clinical studies may not be replicated in the post-market…
The clinical study process is lengthy and expensive with uncertain outcomes
A substantial majority of our revenue is generated from sales of Galleri and we are highly dependent on it for our success
strategy: Establishing Galleri as the population multi-cancer screening standard and extending commercial leadership in large global markets
Expanding access to our products by pursuing FDA approval and reimbursement and coverage from payors
Defining, leading, and expanding adoption of MCED
Leveraging our existing infrastructure to enable and scale our growing business
Driving cutting edge science and technology to continuously improve existing products and develop new products
Sustaining a patient-first corporate culture that attracts top talent
